summary.ru: Мамлюкский султанат — средневековое феодальное государство на Ближнем Востоке, просуществовавшее с 1250 по 1517 годы. Султанат образовался в результате захвата власти в Каире мамлюками, свергнувшими династию Айюбидов.
summary.en: The Mamluk Sultanate, also known as Mamluk Egypt or the Mamluk Empire, was a state that ruled Egypt, the Levant and the Hejaz from the mid-13th to early 16th centuries, with Cairo as its capital. It was ruled by a military caste of mamluks headed by a sultan. The sultanate was established with the overthrow of the Ayyubid dynasty in Egypt in 1250 and was conquered by the Ottoman Empire in 1517. Mamluk history is generally divided into the Turkic or Bahri period (1250–1382) and the Circassian or Burji period (1382–1517), named after the predominant ethnicity or corps of the ruling Mamluks during these respective eras.
